offers.sn: About Glia Glia is the #1 Banking AI platform, empowering community and regional financial institutions to create efficiencies, accelerate loan growth, drive deposits, and deliver experiences that win against megabanks and fintechs.
We believe it takes great people to create a great product. That’s why our team lives our company values, and we hire based on them, too.
offers.rq: Engineer and architect scalable security solutions for cloud-native environments to protect customer data, applications, and networks 7+ years of experience in security engineering, cloud security, or security architecture in a SaaS or cloud-native environment Proficiency in at least one programming language with the ability to write and review production-quality code
